title: Frühneuzeitliche Fürstinnenkorrespondenzen (Fuerstinnenkorrespondenz corpus, LAUDATIO)
notes: DFG project on the letter corpora of early modern princely women of the central German area (~5,500 letters in 24 correspondences; the published corpus v1.1 has ~250k tokens of 16th-c. princesses' letters), published in the LAUDATIO repository (handle resolves and is live 200) with TEI plus morphological/POS annotation, queryable in ANNIS; matches origin 'Fürstinnenkorrespondenz (early-modern German princely women's letters, 16c)'. Related Anhalt/Thuringia letter materials sit in ThULB Jena 'Digitale Fürstinnenkorrespondenzen' collections; a BBAW reuse experiment by Stefan Dumont confirms the free licence of the TEI data. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: Friedrich-Schiller-Universitaet Jena (Rosemarie Luehr, Vera Fasshauer, Daniela Prutscher, Henry Seidel), published in the LAUDATIO repository
